text: The plumbing sandbox adds Bash, pinned to Alpine's 5.3.9-r1 as git is to 2.54.0-r0, so a build can run tests that execute generated GitHub Actions steps with bash, as Actions does (#741). #736's build stopped as a draft only because the sandbox had none. The image stays the pinned Python image with the pinned Go toolchain, offline at check time, under the same CPU, memory, process and deadline limits; only building it fetches packages. #741 was built by hand to save Codex credits, as D-0331's queue was, so the factory doesn't build it again.
